Homemade Vanilla Extract
By: jue
Published: Sunday, April 25, 2010 - 7:53am

Ingredients




1 cup vodka
3 pods vanilla

Preparation

1 Slice the vanilla pods lengthwise and pour measured vodka into the jar. 2 Let it sit for 8 weeks. Shake the bottle every week. 3 On the 8th week, strain the extract into a clean bottle. 4 Do not discard the pods, simply refill again with vodka and start all over again. You may add fresh pods too. 5 Try it and let me know

About


You may double the portion if you wish.
